privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data AnarBib collects, why it is collected, with whom it is shared, and what rights you have over it. The text applies to all libraries using the AnarBib system.
privacy.lib.fallback: This section has not yet been translated to your language. The text below is in Portuguese.
privacy.lib.title: Specifics of {name}
privacy.retention.body: We apply the data minimization principle (GDPR article 5(1)(e), LGPD article 6): no data is kept beyond the time strictly necessary. The default retention durations of the AnarBib network are as follows:
privacy.retention.consultations: Completed on-site consultation history: 12 months after closure
privacy.retention.loans: Completed loan history: 24 months after return
privacy.retention.override: Each library may adopt shorter durations (or longer, by justified collective decision). The durations in force at your library may be indicated in the specific section below, if one has been published.
privacy.retention.profile: Profile and registration data: kept as long as your account exists
privacy.retention.reservations: Completed reservation history: 12 months after closure
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep your data
privacy.s1.body: Each library in the AnarBib network is data controller for the data of its readers in the sense of GDPR (article 4.7) and Brazilian LGPD (article 5, VI). AnarBib, as a technical system operated by Xavier VAN WELDEN, acts as data processor on behalf of the libraries — it provides the tool but does not decide how the data is used. Contact details for each adherent library are available on that library's page. For technical questions about the AnarBib system itself, you can write to contato@anarbib.org.
privacy.s1.title: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.s10.authority: You can also contact the supervisory authority of your country (in France, CNIL — cnil.fr; in the UK, ICO — ico.org.uk; in Brazil, ANPD — gov.br/anpd; in Italy, Garante — garanteprivacy.it).
privacy.s10.body: For any question about this policy or the processing of your data:
privacy.s10.title: How to contact us
privacy.s2.collected: Data collection is limited to the minimum necessary for the library to function:
privacy.s2.item.email: Your email address (for communications regarding loans and reservations)
privacy.s2.item.libraries: The list of network libraries you are a member of
privacy.s2.item.loans: The history of your loans and reservations at the library
privacy.s2.item.name: Your first name or pseudonym, both optional
privacy.s2.item.password: Your password, stored only in encrypted form (bcrypt hash) — never in plaintext, not even librarians can see it
privacy.s2.item.username: Your public identifier (login of your choice)
privacy.s2.notCollected: The following data is NOT collected by AnarBib:
privacy.s2.notItem.analytics: Behavioral analytics tools (Google Analytics, Meta pixels, etc.)
privacy.s2.title: What data AnarBib collects
privacy.s3.body: Data is collected solely to enable the library to function: managing your account, recording loans and reservations, and communicating with you about those operations (availability of a reserved book, return reminders, etc.). No other use is made of it. In particular: no marketing, no behavioral analysis, no profiling.
privacy.s3.title: Why this data is collected
privacy.s4.body: Your account data is retained as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time from the "My account" page, which permanently erases your personal data. Loan history is kept for operational purposes (anonymous library statistics, return management).
privacy.s4.notice: Under development: a mechanism for automatic deletion of completed loans after a duration configurable by each library is planned for a future update. This page will be updated when it is activated.
privacy.s4.title: How long data is retained
privacy.s5.body: You have legal rights over your personal data, guaranteed by European GDPR and Brazilian LGPD:
privacy.s5.exercise: Most of these rights can be exercised directly in the application. To view, modify or delete your data, go to
privacy.s5.right.access: Right of access: see what data the library holds about you
privacy.s5.right.delete: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): delete your account and your data
privacy.s5.right.limit: Right to restriction: request temporary suspension of the processing of your data
privacy.s5.right.object: Right to object: refuse certain types of processing
privacy.s5.right.portable: Right to portability: download your data in a reusable format (under development)
privacy.s5.right.rectify: Right of rectification: correct inaccurate data
privacy.s5.title: Your rights over your data
privacy.s6.body: To operate technically, AnarBib uses three service providers (data processors in the GDPR sense):
privacy.s6.dpa: For libraries that join the AnarBib network, a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) details the contractual responsibilities between each adhering library and AnarBib in compliance with Article 28 of the GDPR and Article 39 of the LGPD.
privacy.s6.noResale: AnarBib never sells, rents, or shares your data for commercial purposes. Never.
privacy.s6.subprocessor.brevo: Brevo SAS — sending of notification emails (return reminders, reservation confirmations, etc.). Servers in the European Union. DPA integrated into Brevo's terms of service.
privacy.s6.subprocessor.codeberg: Codeberg e.V. — hosting of the web interface (frontend). Servers in Germany (EU). German non-profit association.
privacy.s6.subprocessor.supabase: Supabase Inc. — database and authentication. Servers located in São Paulo (Brazil). Data Processing Agreement (DPA) signed on May 4, 2026, with the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (decision 2021/914).
privacy.s6.title: Who your data is shared with
privacy.s6.transfer: Data is therefore transferred outside the European Union, to Supabase's servers in Brazil. This transfer is governed by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses. Brazil has its own data protection law (LGPD), structurally close to GDPR.
privacy.s7.body: Technical measures implemented by AnarBib to protect your data:
privacy.s7.honest: Honestly: no system is perfectly secure. In the event of a data breach affecting your rights, you will be notified by email within the timeframe set by GDPR (72 hours after detection) and the competent supervisory authority will also be notified.
privacy.s7.measure.audit: AnarBib's source code is public and auditable (AGPL-3.0 license)
privacy.s7.measure.hash: Passwords are stored in encrypted form (bcrypt), never in plaintext
privacy.s7.measure.minimization: Data collection is minimized by design: what is not collected cannot leak
privacy.s7.measure.rls: Data access is restricted by security rules in the database (PostgreSQL Row Level Security): each user only sees their own data; each library only sees the data of its readers
privacy.s7.measure.tls: All communications are encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
privacy.s7.title: How your data is protected
privacy.s8.body: In the event of a request to disclose data from a judicial or police authority, AnarBib will respond only to what is strictly required by applicable law, and nothing more. Affected persons will be informed as soon as investigation secrecy permits. The first protection of your data remains the fact that it is not collected if it is not necessary — that is why minimization (section 2) is central to our design. The detailed procedure is described in the INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md document published in our repository.
privacy.s8.title: Position regarding requests from authorities
privacy.s9.body: This policy may be modified to reflect technical or legal developments. Any significant modification will be communicated by email to affected persons. The full history of modifications is available in our public Codeberg repository, in docs/legal/PRIVACY_POLICY.md.
privacy.s9.title: Modifications to this policy
privacy.subtitle: How AnarBib protects your personal data

biblioteca.documents.governance.requireA: Require surplus available now before suggesting an exchange
biblioteca.documents.governance.policyNo: E.g.: only consider exchanges with a clear surplus of copies and good physical condition.
biblioteca.documents.governance.guardrai: E.g.: always keep at least one free copy after the exchange and avoid items in circulation.

biblioteca.policySets.listHint: Each library keeps its own sets; only one is in use at a time.
biblioteca.policySets.selectSetFirst: Select a set above to view and edit its rules.
biblioteca.regime.state1.titleGeneric: Rules linked to a library text in use
biblioteca.regime.state1.text: The set "{set}" is in use and is linked to the {docKind}{version}.
biblioteca.regime.state1.note: This is the expected situation when the rules applied by the system follow the library's public text.
biblioteca.regime.state1.stepsTitle: What to review when something changes
biblioteca.regime.state1.step1: If the public text changes, review the set in use.
biblioteca.regime.state1.step2: Check that the rules still match the text.
biblioteca.regime.state1.step3: Save the adjustments before switching the set in use.
biblioteca.regime.state2.title: Temporary rules in use
biblioteca.regime.state2.text: The set "{set}" is in use, but is not yet linked to any library text.
biblioteca.regime.state2.note: This lets the system keep working while the library has not yet defined or not yet linked its local regulation.
biblioteca.regime.state2.step1: Register or review the library's main text.
biblioteca.regime.state2.step2: Link the set in use to that text.
biblioteca.regime.state2.step3: Check that the rules match the public text.
biblioteca.regime.state3.title: Text in use, but rules not yet activated
biblioteca.regime.state3.text: The text "{docKind}"{version} is in use, but no rule set has been put in use.
biblioteca.regime.state3.note: The library needs to put a set in use so the system knows which loan periods, reservations and renewals to apply.
biblioteca.regime.state3.step1: Create a set linked to that text, if one does not exist yet.
biblioteca.regime.state4.title: Sets are registered, but none in use
biblioteca.regime.state4.text: The library already has registered rule sets, but none has been put in use.
biblioteca.regime.state4.note: Without a set in use, the library relies only on the temporary rules already prepared by the system.
biblioteca.regime.state4.step1: Choose the set that should apply now.
biblioteca.regime.state4.step2: Check that it has at least one rule.
biblioteca.regime.state5.title: Library with no local rules defined
biblioteca.regime.state5.text: No text in use and no rule set in use was found.
biblioteca.regime.state5.note: In the meantime, the system uses default temporary rules so as not to block the account, catalog, panel and book.
biblioteca.regime.state5.step1: First register the library's main text.
biblioteca.regime.state5.step2: Create a rule set for loans, reservations and consultation.
